The documented caution applies — those sizes are not established on the clinical sample and a random split can score a recording-regime signal as gain — so this is deliberately a single attributable transition (preprocessing plus a mild regularisation<path> adjustment on the same family), and if best_cut fails to move the final attempt spends itself consolidating the best operating point instead of chasing more ranking.
